# Remove members, change roles, leave a team space

## What to build

Add owner-only member management and leaving to team spaces: oRPC `spaces.members.remove`, `spaces.members.setRole` and `spaces.leave`, backed by `packages/db/src/space-membership.ts`. When someone leaves or is removed, the work they created in the space stays and is reassigned to an owner wherever an accountable user is required (bots, routines, connections, computers, MCP servers, space secrets, vault credentials, groups, messaging installations, skills). Their access ends at once: their `SpaceMember` and `Member` rows are deleted, so the next request with that space header gets 401, and open thread streams end at the next re-check (`stillAuthorized`, every 10 s). Account deletion is changed so that deleting an account leaves its team spaces first (reassigning its work) instead of deleting its bots there.

## Team space model (already decided; do not change)

- A team space lives in its own `Organization` (the "team organization"), created with it. The org holds exactly one space in v1, so `Member` rows and `SpaceMember` rows of that org are the same people with the same role.
- `Space.kind` is `"private"` (default) or `"team"`. Team spaces are created with `isDefault: false`; the user's personal default space stays their default.
- Roles are `"owner"` and `"member"` on both `Member.role` and `SpaceMember.role`, kept equal.
- Members can invite, cancel invites, and create/edit/delete any bot, routine, credential or connection. Only owners remove members, change roles, and delete the space. Any member can manage the team plan and billing (audited).
- Everything in a team space is visible to every member. Personal data (voice, model preferences, AI-data consent, notification preferences, push tokens, devices, personal model credentials) stays per user.
- Private spaces have one member, so space scoping must behave exactly as before for them.


Already in the codebase: `Space.kind`, `createTeamSpace` (`packages/db/src/spaces.ts`), `spaces.createTeam`, and from the invites slice `packages/db/src/space-invites.ts` (`Invitation.spaceId`, `tokenHash`, `respondedAt`; statuses `pending|accepted|declined|cancelled`), `packages/contracts/src/space-members.ts` (`SpaceRoleSchema`, `SpaceMemberSchema`, `SpaceMembersSchema`), and `apps/api/src/routes/space-members.ts` (`spaceMemberRoutes(ctx)` spread into the `spaces` router object, with `members.list` and `invites.*`). Add the new handlers to that same module and the new contract entries next to `spaces.members.list`.

## Decisions baked in

- `members.remove { spaceId, userId }` → `{}`: caller must be `owner`; cannot target self (`BAD_REQUEST`, use leave); target must be a member (`NOT_FOUND`). Owners can remove other owners as long as one owner remains.
- `members.setRole { spaceId, userId, role }` → `{}`: owner only; updates `Member.role` and `SpaceMember.role` together; demoting the last owner → `BAD_REQUEST`.
- `spaces.leave { spaceId }` → `{ activeSpaceId }` (the caller's personal default space id): only for `kind: "team"` (private → `BAD_REQUEST`); the last owner cannot leave while other members exist (`BAD_REQUEST` "Make someone else an owner first, or delete the space"); a sole member who is the owner also gets `BAD_REQUEST` (they delete the space instead).
- Reassignment target: on removal, the removing owner; on leave, the remaining owner with the oldest `SpaceMember.createdAt`.
- On leave/removal also: cancel pending invites the person sent for this space and pending invites to their email for this space; delete their per-member rows in the space (`notificationPreference`, `actionAutoReviewPreference`, anything else keyed by `(spaceId, userId)` that is personal; `SpaceSettingOverride`, `SpaceModelPreference`, `SpaceVoicePreference`, `SpaceModelRoleChoice`, `AiDataConsent` cascade from `SpaceMember`, verify in the schema).
- Threads and messages keep their `userId` as "created by"; do not reassign them.
- Account deletion: before `claimSpacesLeavingWithAccount`, for every team space the user belongs to that has other members, run the leave logic with "force" semantics: if the user is the last owner, first promote the remaining member with the oldest membership to owner.
- Audit actions: `space.member.removed`, `space.member.left`, `space.member.role_changed` (metadata `{ role }`).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` — `Member` 339-353, `SpaceMember` 436-455 (FK to `Member` with `onDelete: Cascade`, so deleting the `member` row removes the `space_members` row), `Bot` 640-707 (`userId` bare column), `BotSection` 710-726 (`@@unique([spaceId, userId, name])`), `ChatGroup` 741-760, `Routine` 1092-1128, `Connection` 1223-1240, `McpServer` 1562-1604 (`@@unique([spaceId, userId, slug])`, FK to User cascade, and a flag documented "Available in every space of its owner"), `AgentSkill` 1196-1221 (same flag; case-insensitive unique `(spaceId, userId, lower(name))` in SQL), `Secret` 1545-1560 (`spaceId String?`), `VaultCredential` 1786-1802 (unique `(userId, spaceId, name)` NULLS NOT DISTINCT in SQL), `Computer` 1344-1397, `MessagingInstallation` 2143-2161, `NotificationPreference` 1516-1527, `ActionAutoReviewPreference` 324-337.
- `packages/db/src/spaces.ts` — transaction and advisory-lock patterns (`lockSpaceDeletion`), `claimSpacesLeavingWithAccount` (skips spaces with other members), `personalOrganizationIds`.
- `apps/api/src/account-deletion.ts` lines 20-90 — `deleteAccountContent`: `bot.findMany({ where: { OR: [{ userId }, { spaceId: { in: leaving } }] } })` deletes the user's bots in **every** space today; `computer.findMany` at ~67 likewise. Must exclude team spaces the user left.
- `apps/api/src/app.ts` lines 915-975 — `requestSession`/`stillAuthorized`: re-resolves membership, so deleting `SpaceMember` revokes access and ends streams within ~10-20 s. No extra realtime work needed.
- `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts` — error mapping conventions; `apps/api/src/routes/space-members.ts` — where to add handlers.
- `packages/db/src/audit-events.ts` lines 19-72.
- `apps/api/src/space-availability.postgres.test.ts` lines 46-79 — multi-user fixtures.

## Patterns to follow

```ts
// Serializable + retry, as in packages/db/src/spaces.ts createSpaceForMember
await withTransactionRetry(() => prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  await tx.$queryRaw(Prisma.sql`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(${spaceId}, 0))::text AS "lock"`);
  ...
}, { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.Serializable }));
```
Error classes: `LastOwnerError` → `BAD_REQUEST`, `NotSpaceOwnerError` → `FORBIDDEN`, `SpaceMemberNotFoundError` → `NOT_FOUND`, `NotTeamSpaceError` (reuse from space-invites) → `BAD_REQUEST`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/db/src/space-membership.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** `reassignSpaceContent(tx, { spaceId, fromUserId, toUserId })`: `updateMany` `userId` from → to, filtered by `spaceId`, on `bot`, `routine`, `connection`, `computer`, `chatGroup`, `messagingInstallation`, `taughtSkill`, `botMcpServer`, `secret` (`spaceId` = this space only, never `spaceId: null` personal rows), `vaultCredential` (`spaceId` = this space only), `mcpServer` and `agentSkill` (only rows with `spaceId` = this space; also clear the "available in every space" flag so they stay in this space). For unique keys that include `userId`:
  - `botSection`: for each of the leaver's sections, if the target has a section with the same name, move `bots` and `groups` (`sectionId`) to it and delete the leaver's; otherwise reassign it.
  - `mcpServer` slug / `agentSkill` name / `vaultCredential` name collisions: rename the leaver's row by appending `-2` (slug) or ` (2)` (name) before reassigning (loop until free).
- **IMPLEMENT** `removeSpaceMember(prisma, { spaceId, actorUserId, targetUserId })`, `setSpaceMemberRole(prisma, { spaceId, actorUserId, targetUserId, role })`, `leaveSpace(prisma, { spaceId, userId, promoteIfLastOwner?: boolean })` → returns `{ activeSpaceId }`. Each: Serializable tx with the space advisory lock; load both memberships and `space.kind`; enforce rules above; for removal/leave: `reassignSpaceContent`, cancel invites, delete personal per-member rows, then `tx.member.delete({ where: { organizationId_userId } })` (cascades `space_members`).
- **GOTCHA**: run inside `runAsSystem` from callers; these writes cross users so tenant context would block them.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/db check`

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/index.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: export the new functions and errors.

### UPDATE `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `spaces.members` add `remove: oc.input(z.object({ spaceId: Id, userId: Id })).output(z.object({}))`, `setRole: oc.input(z.object({ spaceId: Id, userId: Id, role: SpaceRoleSchema })).output(z.object({}))`; in `spaces` add `leave: oc.input(z.object({ spaceId: Id })).output(z.object({ activeSpaceId: Id }))`.

### UPDATE `apps/api/src/routes/space-members.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** the three handlers (membership via `asMemberOf`-style check, then `runAsSystem`), error mapping, audit events with `target: { type: "user", id: targetUserId }`. Put `leave` under the `spaces` object (it is `spaces.leave`).
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/api check`

### UPDATE `apps/api/src/account-deletion.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: at the start of `deleteAccountContent`, find the user's memberships in `kind: "team"` spaces with other members and call `leaveSpace(prisma, { spaceId, userId, promoteIfLastOwner: true })` for each (inside `runAsSystem`). The existing bot/computer queries then no longer find their reassigned rows in those spaces.

### CREATE `apps/api/src/space-membership.postgres.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: fixture = team space with owner A, member B (insert `member` + `space_members` rows directly), plus a bot, routine, connection, team-space `vaultCredential` and `botSection` created by B. Cases: A removes B → B's `spaceMember`/`member` gone, `requireMembership(prisma, B, teamSpaceId)` throws `IsolationError`, B's bot/routine/connection/vault credential now have `userId = A`, bots still exist; B removes A → `FORBIDDEN`; A sets B owner → both role columns `owner`; A demotes self while sole owner → `BAD_REQUEST`; A leaves as sole owner with B present → `BAD_REQUEST`; B leaves → content reassigned to A and `{ activeSpaceId }` is B's personal space; leave on a private space → `BAD_REQUEST`; pending invites sent by B are `cancelled`; section-name collision merges; account deletion of B (call `deleteAccountContent` with fake sandbox deps, see existing `apps/api/src/account-deletion.postgres.test.ts` if present, else test `leaveSpace(..., { promoteIfLastOwner: true })` directly) keeps B's bot in the team space owned by A; audit rows written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `spaces.members.remove` (owner) → `{}`; the removed user gets 401 for that space header; their bots and routines keep running, now owned by the remover.
- [ ] `spaces.members.setRole` updates both role columns; last-owner demotion refused.
- [ ] `spaces.leave` → `{ activeSpaceId }`; last owner cannot leave; private spaces cannot be left.
- [ ] Deleting an account never deletes its bots or routines in a team space that has other members.
- [ ] Audit events for remove, leave and role change.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run packages/db/src apps/api/src/routes
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=space-membership
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
